resource_governance.rationale: 120000 is a transparent two-times-reference annotation, not a statistical anomaly test. 200000 is a round proposed operational backstop, not an owner-approved financial/scientific ceiling or calibrated probability bound. It allows the previously illustrated 122304-token continuation and a 158304-token trace with 30000 base input per request, two full candidate outputs and one output-sized history replay; larger lawful traces can still trip it. Lower triggers reduce exposure but may stop useful long-context reasoning; higher triggers postpone detection of excessive work. Lowering the per-response setting can itself force extra context replay. Neither trigger establishes actual provider-work prevention.
resource_governance.billing: Token consumption, CLI list-price estimates and actual subscription charges are separate records. Attributable charges/currency remain UNKNOWN unless independently observable. No assumed zero charge, subscription-fee proration, API switch, overage enablement or monetary authorisation follows.
resource_governance.run_totals: Record cumulative actual component/combined totals and unknown-entry counts after every attempt, with fixed summaries after blocks 1, 2 and 3. 12 x 60000 = 720000 is only a planning reference, not a run cap. No new run-wide token ceiling is proposed. Approaching 12 x 200000 would indicate a very resource-intensive workflow, not an authorised spend or guaranteed maximum. No condition-specific top-ups or adaptive baseline/median rules.

strict_integrity_rules.second_generation: Only an evidenced append-only output-limit continuation of the same unfinished response, within the same parent invocation, same task/model/context, preserving original fragments and exact terminal assembly.
strict_integrity_rules.always_stop_independent_of_usage: Third generation, unexplained request IDs, missing/changing identity, unverified continuation, any schema/semantic repair, replacement, best-of/refinement, extra parent call, model/account/environment deviation, auth/rate/timeout, journal integrity/ownership/lock failure or contaminated monitoring. Retain simultaneous faults even if a numeric emergency is also reached.
strict_integrity_rules.ordinary_format_failure: Retain the earlier proposed distinction: a malformed JSON/schema/lane-semantic response with otherwise intact identity/generation/account/usage controls consumes its slot and may advance once to the next frozen slot; no repair or replacement. This rule still needs final protocol approval.
strict_integrity_rules.unchanged_runtime_safeguards: Medium requested, retries=0, max agentic turns=2, no tools/formatter/MCP/skills, fresh contexts/sterile directories, proposed 600-second attempt and 1800-second condition wall limits, 30/180-minute generation/review human limits, existing bounded IO and durable originals. None is a token certificate or new execution authority.

observability_and_future_implementation: No reliable live aggregate usage stream has been established. Assistant output placeholders, byte sizes and fictional averages are not a token meter. Best-effort cancellation cannot prevent already-started/provider work. A newly versioned collector/accounting/package policy and offline regressions must be reviewed before adopting R3; current code still applies the old rigid R2 rule and must not be presented as R3-ready.
fairness_and_analysis: Freeze identical references, flags, emergency comparator, timing/IO safeguards and stopping rules for all four conditions before any generation. Report every attempt/condition's actual input components, output/thinking details, combined/cumulative usage, visible generations, unknowns, flags, interruptions, wall/human effort and separately observable charges. Usage is an experimental outcome, not a quality score or equal-resources claim. Do not select only inexpensive/successful cards. A stop before every scheduled slot finishes leaves an incomplete run; preserve all 12/24 intended denominators and undispatched slots. If an emergency is discovered only after the final slot, report all recorded slots plus the emergency separately; do not invent missing data or claim an event-free run. Independent human review/interpretation remains required.
